title: Krillion
description: Play the original Krillion Daily Dive: seven open-ended trivia prompts, 25 seconds per answer, and a score that rewards surprising but correct answers. The rarer your answer, the deeper you dive. Play takes place on the creator’s own website so your daily challenge, progress and unlocks stay there.
shortDescription: Dive into seven daily trivia prompts. Uncommon correct answers score more.
licenseNotes: The official creator runs Krillion at krillion.io and prohibits embedding with X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and CSP frame-ancestors self. Sidequest only links to the original website, does not copy or self-host its game files, and has no partnership or licence to reproduce them. The creator controls daily prompts, accounts, paid content, privacy, ads and availability.
controls: Type a correct answer to each trivia prompt using the keyboard or your phone’s on-screen keyboard. Follow the timer on the original game page.
instructions: Select “Play at Krillion” to open the original game in a new tab. Choose Daily Dive, read the category, then enter one valid answer before the timer ends. There are seven prompts per dive, and unusual correct answers earn deeper scores. Other modes may require unlocks on the creator’s website.

title: Skribbl.io
description: Draw clues and guess what your friends are drawing in live online multiplayer rounds. Create a private room on the official Skribbl.io website and invite friends with a link.
shortDescription: Multiplayer drawing and guessing with private rooms.
controls: Use your mouse, trackpad or touch to draw. Type guesses into the chat and press Enter.
instructions: Choose Play now to load the official embedded Skribbl.io game inside Sidequest. Enter a nickname, create or join a room, and take turns drawing and guessing. Private rooms and scoring are managed by Skribbl.io.
licenseNotes: The game is displayed through the exact Miniplay iframe endpoint published on the public game page. Sidequest does not download, proxy, modify, or self-host the game. Online rooms, cookies, ads and saved data remain under the provider and original publisher. The host network may restrict access; the creator link remains available.

title: TAG
description: Fast same-screen multiplayer tag for two to four friends. Whoever is "it" when the timer ends loses; chase, dodge and switch roles in a frantic local arena.
shortDescription: Chase and dodge in 2–4 player same-keyboard TAG.
controls: Player 1: W/A/D. Player 2: arrow keys. Players 3 and 4 use the additional keys shown on the original game screen.
instructions: Choose Play now to start the TAG embed inside Sidequest. Choose 2–4 players on the same computer; the player who is “it” at the end of the round loses. This is same-screen local multiplayer, not internet matchmaking.
licenseNotes: The game is displayed through the exact Miniplay iframe endpoint published on the public game page. Sidequest does not download, proxy, modify, or self-host the game. title: WorldGuessr
description: A free worldwide Street View guessing game. Look around for clues, place a pin where you think you are, and compete with friends in private parties or ranked duels on the official WorldGuessr website.
shortDescription: Explore Street View and guess locations for free.
controls: Pan, zoom and move in Street View; click or tap the map to place your guess. Use the controls displayed by the original game.
instructions: Choose Play now to load WorldGuessr inside Sidequest. Start a free single-player round, or create a private party to challenge friends. Guess as close as possible to the Street View location.
